title: Several WSO2 products: attackers can read or change files
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 94 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. The severity score is critical (10.0).

category.label: Website or online store
category.why: It runs public websites, online stores or the software behind them.
category.doThis: Ask whoever runs your website or store to update it.

summary: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 27, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

evidence.title: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
4 public GitHub repositories claim a proof of concept for CVE-2026-5430
CISA Vulnrichment marks CVE-2026-5430 as actively exploited
